title: A user without the View permission sees neither Inventory tab
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NOVIEW) is a staff member at {Location-A} whose custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NOVIEW) has the Parts department on (for example with Part Sales → View) and every 'Part Library & Inventory' box unticked.
  • {User-B} is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser or a private window.
custom_steps:
1. As {User-B}, open the Parts section from the top bar.
  2. Look for Inventory in the Parts side menu.
  3. Type the Inventory page address (the address ending /parts/inventory) in the browser's address bar and press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Inventory is not offered in the Parts side menu.
  • Step 3: The Inventory list does not open: neither the Active nor the Inactive tab is shown.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-N2, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows this. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-N2: “A user who cannot view the Inventory list sees neither tab.”
